Quick Looting

Version

11.50.6055
December 5, 2017
Winter Update 2017

Status

Active

Quick Looting is a system that was introduced with the Winter Update 2017 to make looting faster and more effective. In order to organize your loots, players are able to manage their loot Containers and assign them to different categories of items, e.g. default, Gold and Creature Products. Items picked up via Quick Looting are automatically sorted between these containers (if the player is premium). The item categories are the same used by the Market and the Cyclopedia, with the addition with one category for money.

Quick Looting was first presented to players as a Dev Note on August 10, 2017.

Default Food Tools
Gold Helmets and Hats Weapons: Ammo
Armors Legs Weapons: Axes
Amulets Valuables Weapons: Clubs
Boots Potions Weapons: Distance
Containers Rings Weapons: Swords
Creature Products Runes Weapons: Wands
Decorations Shields Others

Containers assigned to at least one category will display an icon on top of them. Hovering the cursor over it will show you its assigned categories.

Looting

Quick Looting is comprised of two features which are always active and can be used simultaneously. Note that the only restriction for Free Account players is the category sorting, both Loot All and Loot Click features are available for all players.

Loot All

The Loot All feature sends all the items inside a creature's corpse to the corresponding loot containers once the corpse is clicked. The mouse button and key (if used) combination can be changed on the Options menu and also depends on the player's mouse preset. You can also add items to the Accepted Loot (white) or Skipped Loot (black) lists to use along the Loot All option. When using the Accepted Loot mode, only the selected items will be looted. On the other hand, when using the Skipped Loot mode, all items but those selected will be looted. Items can be added or removed from the lists using the Cyclopedia or simply by opening their context menu and choosing Add to Loot List or Remove from Loot List, which also works for items not on the Cyclopedia. The Loot All feature works on stacks of up to 30 corpses on the same map field since the Winter Update 2020.

Currently these are the possible mouse button and key combinations available:

  • Classic Controls
    • Left click - When using this option, your character will loot the corpse instead of walking over it.
    • Right click - When using this option, your character will loot the corpse instead of opening it.
    • ⇧ Shift + Right click- This option does not change any default control but is less practical.
  • Regular Controls
    • ⇧ Shift + Right click
  • Left Smart-Click
    • Alt + Left click

Loot Click

The Loot Click feature makes moving items from the corpse to the corresponding containers easier, simply by left-clicking them, instead of dragging.

Filters

In order to select what items will or will not be picked up during Quick Looting, players can use one of two possible lists: Skipped Loot or Accepted Loot.

It's recommended that the Skipped Loot list is used, and that items of low value which you do not want to pick up are added to it. This ensures that you will never leave a valuable item behind because it wasn't in your Accepted Loot list, and whenever you come across a new item you don't want to loot, you can just add it to the list and toss the ones you already picked up.
